method: Deterministic metadata and source-locator audit for every record, with expanded pre-review notes for Gold v1 records. It identifies review risks and public-use limits; it is not direct source re-review, outside validation, endorsement, ranking, prevalence measurement, or legal adjudication.
public_claim_limit: This audit is an internal pre-review triage artifact. It must not be described as third-party review, external validation, institutional quality judgment, safety scoring, severity scoring, frequency measurement, or legal finding.
